palette.description: The currently selected palette. Possible values: 'night', 'dusk', 'day', 'bright'. Defaults to 'day'.

brightness.description: The current brightness value (0–100). Defaults to 50.

showLinkBrightness.description: Whether the menu draws the switch that links the brightness to other screens. False by default: Cadre links nothing.

showLinkPalette.description: Whether the menu draws the switch that links the palette to other screens. False by default: Cadre links nothing.

variant.description: The variant of the menu. Possible values: 'normal', 'compact', 'tabbed'. Defaults to 'normal'.

brightnessUnit.description: The unit of the brightness value.

brightnessMax.description: The maximum value of the brightness slider.

brightnessMinorStep.description: The minor step of the brightness slider.

brightnessMajorStep.description: The major step of the brightness slider.

brightnessInputVariant.description: The variant of the brightness input.

showScreenControlLink.description: If true, displays the screen control link.

showBrightness.description: Whether the menu draws the brightness section.

showPalette.description: Whether the menu draws the palette (day and night) section.

componentSize.description: OpenBridge component size: regular, medium, large or xl.
